transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?
I guess… I’ve been thinking my wife and the kids might be better off if I just didn’t wake up. I’ve said a few times I don’t need to see another winter.
Have you made any specific plans or preparations for ending your life?
I… no, I don’t want to get into details. It’s more that I keep thinking they’d be better off if I just didn’t wake up. I’ve said I don’t need to see another winter.
Have you made any specific plans or preparations for ending your life?

I don’t… I don’t really want to talk about plans. It’s more just that thought again, that my wife and the kids might be better off if I didn’t wake up. I’ve been saying I don’t need to see another winter.
Have you felt this way before, or has this been happening for a long time?
It’s been… a while. Since my bowling partner died, I guess. That was about a year and a month ago.
Have you lost interest in things you used to enjoy, like hobbies or spending time with family?

Yeah… I guess so. I used to look forward to bridge, working in the garden, helping with the church cooking… even Cubs games. Now I mostly just sit in my chair. I can’t really make myself care about any of it.
Have you felt down or hopeless most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks at any point since your bowling partner passed away?
I… I don’t know how to measure it exactly. It’s been more bad days than not, I guess. I haven’t really kept track.
Can you tell me if there was a time when you felt down or hopeless almost every day for a period of at least two weeks?
Yeah… I suppose so. It’s been like that since he died — my bowling partner. About a year and a month now.
Can you tell me if there was a time in the past two months when you felt down or hopeless almost every day for at least two weeks in a row?
Yes… yes, in the past two months too. It’s really been that way since my bowling partner died, about a year and a month ago.
Have you felt down or lost interest in things for reasons that feel like more than just missing your bowling partner?

Yeah… it’s not just missing him, I don’t think. I used to look forward to bridge, working in the garden, cooking at church, even Cubs games. Now I mostly just sit in my chair and… I can’t make myself care about any of it.
Before the death of your bowling partner, was there a time when you felt like yourself again, where you were not feeling down or losing interest in things?
No… not really. Since he died, about a year and a month ago, I haven’t felt like myself again.
Before the death of your bowling partner, had you ever experienced a time when you felt down or lost interest in things for at least two weeks?
I… I don’t really know. Nothing like this comes to mind before then.
Before the death of your bowling partner, had you ever experienced a period of at least two weeks where you felt down or lost interest in things almost every day?
I don’t think so. I mean… I may have had bad stretches like anybody, but not every day for two weeks, not that I remember.
Before the death of your bowling partner, had you ever experienced a period where you felt down or lost interest in things almost every day for at least two weeks?
No… like I said, this really started after my bowling partner died. It’s been about a year and a month now.
Have there been any periods since your bowling partner died when you felt completely free of these symptoms, even for a short time?
Not really… no. It’s just sort of been there since he died, about a year and a month ago.
